verdict.rationale: Notte documents live session watching: session output includes a ViewerUrl for watching the browser live, and the marketing site advertises 'Live View & Replays: Screenshare & session playback'. However, nothing in the evidence shows a human taking interactive control mid-run when the agent gets stuck. The exposed CDP endpoint only allows programmatic Playwright attachment, not a documented human-takeover flow. Missing for 10: documented human takeover or interactive control in the live viewer, agent pause/resume and handoff mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration of the live view.
